real_binary: trill-session + trill-app-window from SHA256-verified CI ELF bundle
host_scope: ephemeral private Linux/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; both DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY absent; no compositor
method: Repeated 50 real Launch(research,notes) requests followed immediately by Cancel(id, exact session generation) using a raw Unix socket; snapshots separate from effect acknowledgements
original_strict_test_problem: test-strict-request-ipc.py wrongly required a Task response from Cancel after a Running spawn; native GUI exits during the independent IPC round-trip without a display
new_acceptance: Allow the exact no-owned-child error only if a following Session Snapshot independently observes FAILED; never translate the error into CANCELLED or a successful Hepta effect. Verify task ID and eventual reap separately.
